name: Record of Ragnarok
description: Before eradicating humankind from the world, the gods give them one last chance to prove themselves worthy of survival. Let the Ragnarok battles begin.

videos.title: Ragnarok
videos.overview: At the Council of Valhalla, the gods vote unanimously for humankind's extinction. But Brunhilde, eldest of the Valkyrie sisters, raises her objection.

videos.title: Worthy Opponent
videos.overview: In the first round of the Ragnarok battle, Han dynasty warlord Lü Bu puts up a good fight against Norse god Thor, surprising the gods in attendance.

videos.title: Killer Move
videos.overview: To give Lü Bu the upper hand against Thor, Brünnhilde summons her sister Randgriz and asks her to transform into a sacred weapon — the Shield Breaker.

videos.title: Joy
videos.overview: Lü Bu's legs are crushed by the mighty Geirröd Thor's Hammer attack, but just when all hope seems lost, the warlord's trusty horse Red Hare rides in.

videos.title: FILE No.00000000001
videos.overview: Chosen for the next round is the father of humankind and the man bearing more hatred towards the gods than anyone else: Adam himself.

videos.title: Great Emulation
videos.overview: Zeus insists on going up against Adam, who joins forces with Valkyrie Reginleif to obtain a most peculiar weapon: a knuckleduster.

videos.title: Expelled from Paradise
videos.overview: Just when it looks like Adam will earn humankind the victory they long for, Zeus gathers his strength to ask Adam why he's really fighting.

videos.title: Grace Abounding
videos.overview: Zeus has transformed into his final most powerful form, but after the beating he's suffered, he may not last much longer in the fight.

videos.title: Tyrant of the Ocean
videos.overview: Humankind is desperate to win the next bout, but the god they're going up against is one of the mightiest of them all: Poseidon.

videos.title: Greatest Loser
videos.overview: Kojiro Sasaki uses his mighty Tsubame Gaeshi move to finish off Poseidon, but the god of the sea won't be sunk so easily.

videos.title: The Swallow Gazes into the Abyss
videos.overview: Through the power of Valkyrie Hrist, Kojiro's broken blade is transformed into dual swords, allowing him to tap into the depths of his inner strength.

videos.title: And Ragnarok Goes On
videos.overview: Despite Kojiro's Niten Ganryu duel blade method, Poseidon's powerful attacks continue to wear him down. But the battle isn't over yet.

videos.title: Good vs. Evil
videos.overview: The gods have no intention of letting the humans win the next round; for their next fighter, they present none other than the great hero, Hercules.

videos.title: The Indomitable War God
videos.overview: The spectators notice that the tattoos on Hercules have grown significantly — and if they continue to grow, the hero will suffer a painful death.

videos.title: Birth of a Monster
videos.overview: In late 19th century London, the young son of a prostitute has a special ability that helps him survive the poverty he was born into.

videos.title: The Final Labor
videos.overview: Although he’s lost his left arm, Hercules remains steadfast, easily summoning the strength to unleash his ultimate move: the Twelfth Labor.

videos.title: Requiem
videos.overview: The brutal fourth round has pushed both fighters beyond their breaking point; when the winner is finally announced, there is no joy or celebration.

videos.title: Conflicting Motives
videos.overview: To capitalize on humanity's momentum, Brünnhilde pays a visit to the colossal Tameemon Raiden, the most powerful sumo wrestler in history.

videos.title: Hundred Seals
videos.overview: Stepping into the sumo ring to take on Tameemon Raiden is the God of Destruction, the Destroyer himself: Supreme Lord Shiva.

videos.title: The Pinnacle of 1116
videos.overview: Years ago, Shiva spent many happy days with his best friend Rudra. Then one day, Rudra asks Shiva to join him on a journey to the top.

videos.title: Resonance
videos.overview: As a child, Raiden had to suppress his full strength so he wouldn’t hurt other people. But now, to win this battle, he’s not holding anything back.

videos.title: The Brink
videos.overview: The match comes to a moving end. Even Zeus is impressed by humanity's powerful spirit; but he's going to make sure the gods get the ultimate victory.

videos.title: Round Six
videos.overview: With the scoreboard almost neck-and-neck, Buddha declares that he'll fight in the next round — but whose side will he be fighting on?

videos.title: Zero
videos.overview: Struck by the amount of suffering humans must endure, Zerofuku decides to absorb all of their unhappiness, but it still isn't enough to end their pain.

videos.title: The strongest puberty in history
videos.overview: There was once a prince who was born into great wealth and given the very best of everything. But one day, he decides to leave it all behind.

videos.title: Legend of the Underworld
videos.overview: Nobody knows who the strange new creature is, but he's clearly very strong. And most worryingly, Buddha can't foresee his new opponent's next moves.

videos.title: The Way of Light
videos.overview: It looks like the match is over. But then Buddha gets up, looking stronger than ever. Will he be able to gain another crucial point for the humans?

videos.title: Prologue: Recollections
videos.overview: While humanity celebrates, the sixth round's result rattles the gods. Brunhilde and Hermes reflect on the previous battles and humanity's resilience.

videos.title: King vs. King
videos.overview: With the gods desperate for a win, Hades steps up to avenge his brother. Humanity sends Qin Shi Huang, setting the stage for a monumental clash of kings.

videos.title: Chi You
videos.overview: After uniting China, Qin Shi Huang ascends Mount Tai alone to prove himself before the demon god Chi You. There, he masters the ultimate martial art.

videos.title: A Promise and an Oath
videos.overview: As a child, Qin Shi Huang's daily life is filled with hostility. Yet over time, he finds happiness in the close bond he forms with his strict caretaker.

videos.title: Pride of the King of Helheim
videos.overview: As the seventh round heats up, Hades gouges his own chest, humming as blood pours out and empowers his divine weapon with new strength.

videos.title: Return of the King
videos.overview: On the brink of death, Qin Shi Huang draws strength from Alvitr, unleashing the Force of the Phoenix again. Hades readies his spear for the final blow.

videos.title: Satan
videos.overview: For the eighth round, the gods choose Beelzebub, the god cursed by Satan. Though shunned by all, he once had three close friends who shaped his destiny.

videos.title: Light vs. Shadow
videos.overview: While struggling with Beelzebub's vibration-based powers, Tesla recognizes them as a form of science and counters with the full force of human ingenuity.

videos.title: A Curse and a Prayer
videos.overview: Tesla traps Beelzebub in the Gematria Zone and unleashes the Tesla Step, but Beelzebub learns to nullify the onslaught. The gods expect victory, but...

videos.title: The Torch Passed On
videos.overview: Even after Beelzebub unleashes Helheim's forbidden technique, Tesla stands firm. As the battle peaks, he recalls childhood memories of his brother.

videos.title: Progress
videos.overview: Though battered, Tesla is relentless, pushing Beelzebub on the defensive and to his limits. The showdown between science versus myth reaches its climax.

videos.title: The Sun God and the Rebellious Hero
videos.overview: The gods' next fighter is Apollo, the radiant sun god. Representing humanity is King Leonidas of Sparta. As round nine begins, neither will back down.

videos.title: Pride vs. Pride
videos.overview: In the past, King Leonidas of Sparta defies Apollo's prophecies and goes to war. Now, with his pride on the line, he delivers a decisive strike at Apollo.

videos.title: Know Thyself
videos.overview: Fueled by unyielding resolve, Leonidas slams Apollo down. As the bloodied god rises, most gods scorn his pride, but Zeus and Ares see the truth.

videos.title: A Clash of Souls
videos.overview: Both fighters near death but stand tall, honoring each other's valor. Leonidas transforms his shield and advances as Apollo draws his mythical bow.

language: Japanese, English, French, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, Hungarian
